english.title: Issuing body fail to comply with format / contents requirements for pre printed blank stock
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an issuing body, failed to ensure that

(A)_[pre-printed blank stock which you held or maintained]_
(B)_[an ID which you issued from pre-printed blank stock which you held or maintained]_

contained a serial number that was printed on each of the pages which formed sections I to III of the ID as set out in Annex I to Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2015/262
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 9(1), 22(3) and 34 of the Equine Identification (Wales) Regulations 2019.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
issuing body
failed to ensure
stocks of pre-printed blank ID which it held / maintained AND
any ID which it issued from pre-printed blank stock
must contain a serial number
that is printed on each of the pages which form sections I to III of the ID (as set out in Annex I to the Commission Implementing Regulation (EU 2015 / 262))

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine

6 monthsNote
